title: Recipe 08 — Batch Worker (pull, run, ack, drain)

beats.label: Open the recipe
beats.cue: “Recipe 08 is the shape for process-N-tasks-overnight: the caller never blocks on the model, the worker pulls, runs and acks.”

beats.label: Start from a blank spec
beats.cue: live/ is scratch — the committed recipe is never touched by a take.

beats.label: Load the API key
beats.cue: [needs-key] Sources demos/.env — each job is one single-turn model call, so a real drain needs Anthropic credentials.

groups.title: Beat 1 · The spec — an agent and a queue

beats.label: Name it, pick the shape
beats.cue: “target: batch” — one queue consumer, one single-turn chat loop per job.

beats.label: Add the agent block
beats.cue: “The job body becomes the user message. One sentence back, no tools — that is the whole per-job contract.”

beats.label: Declare the queue
beats.cue: “Adapter, visibility window, retry cap. Swap the adapter for sqs or redis-streams and nothing above this line changes.”

beats.label: Seed four jobs
beats.cue: “seedJobs is in-memory only — the cheapest way to watch a worker drain before you point it at real infrastructure.”

beats.label: Set concurrency and the dedup window
beats.cue: “Four slots per process, and an idempotency key that stays warm for a minute. Total throughput is concurrency times worker count.”

beats.label: Close it out
beats.cue: “Default permissions: this worker calls no tools at all, so there is nothing to allow.”

beats.label: Lint the spec
beats.cue: “Parse plus the IR passes the compile path skips — nothing emitted yet.”

beats.label: Show the lowered IR
beats.cue: “The spec is sugar; this JSON is what the compiler sees — adapter, timeouts, the four job bodies.”

verify.note: 30 lines of IR for target batch, redirected to scratch — the next beat opens it

beats.label: Open the IR
beats.cue: “Nothing about queues is in your code. It is all in this record.”

beats.label: Compile the bundle — and check it
beats.cue: “--check asserts the shape, installs the deps and boots it. Batch is the rare shape where boot runs to completion with no key: GREEN, booted and exited cleanly.”

verify.note: GREEN — assertion ok (6 anchors); install ok; boot ok (booted and exited cleanly)

beats.label: Open the emitted worker
beats.cue: “The pull loop, the slot gate, the visibility renewer and the SIGTERM drain — all of it emitted, none of it yours to maintain.”

beats.label: Try crewhaus run first
beats.cue: “Deliberate rejection, exit 1: only cli and browser run straight from the spec. Batch is compile-first.”

verify.note: measured: `crewhaus run supports target: cli or browser (got "batch")`

beats.label: Run the worker
beats.cue: [needs-key] “Four jobs, four slots, four job_start events at once — then job_end pairs, queue_idle, and the process exits on its own.”

verify.note: consumes the 4 seeded jobs against Anthropic; deps were installed by the --check beat

beats.label: Read one job's transcript
beats.cue: [needs-key] “Each job is its own chat loop, so the worker leaves four sessions behind. This is the most recent one.”

verify.note: with no id, tail picks the most-recently-updated session in .crewhaus/sessions/ (gitignored). Needs the beat above to have run — the store does not exist otherwise.

groups.title: One more thing · the failure taxonomy, with no key at all

beats.label: Run it with the key scrubbed
beats.cue: “Every job now fails on purpose. Watch the taxonomy do its work: transient, transient, then permanent at maxRetries — and the worker still exits 0.”
beats.command: env -u ANTHROPIC_API_KEY -u ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN bun live/dist/agent.ts > live/drain.log 2>&1

verify.note: measured exit 0: 4 jobs × 3 attempts = 12 nacks (transient, transient, permanent), 4 to the dead-letter queue, then queue_idle → drain_start → drain_end → worker_stop. Scrubbed explicitly because the Setup group already sourced .env into this shell.

beats.label: Show the drain sequence
beats.cue: “queue_idle, drain_start, drain_end, worker_stop. Twelve nacks, four dead-lettered, nothing lost — that is the same path a Kubernetes SIGTERM takes.”

verify.note: four matching lines, with the nacked/deadLetter tallies on the queue_idle and worker_stop stats

beats.label: Open the whole log
beats.cue: “Read the attempt numbers climb: 1, 2, 3 per job. maxRetries: 3 is the line between re-enqueue and dead letter.”
